scope: a tenant challenging a rent increase, including nullity for defect of form

requests.why: The landlord’s original rent-increase notice is needed to verify the absence of the required official form and the stated justification.
Diese Unterlagen belegen Inhalt, behaupteten Zustellzeitpunkt und das Fehlen des vorgeschriebenen kantonalen Formulars bei der Mietzinserhöhung.
A copy of the 3 September 2025 rent-increase letter is needed to document that the landlord used no canton-approved official form and to verify its stated contents and effective date.

These documents are needed to verify whether a cantonal-approved, properly reasoned rent-increase form was issued and how the notice was sent, since the described ordinary letter may render the increase void.
Obtain the complete rent-increase letter and any enclosures to verify that no prescribed official form was used and that the stated reason was limited to “Anpassung an die Marktmiete.”
